# DUM-SDK 0.14.1

The Paper plugin is now standalone. This release also introduces publication through GitHub Actions, with versioned release notes and verified release signatures.

## Changes since 0.14.0

- Remove the DUM-Core dependency from the Paper plugin and its build. SDK-owned code now handles player messages and the handshake lifecycle.
- Keep existing configuration, message overrides, bundled message defaults, published module catalogs and the public `DumSdkApi` service working.
- Build and test Paper on public GitHub Actions runners alongside the client and network projects. Build artifacts include both plugin and client jars.
- Add the Release workflow, triggered manually on `main` or by pushing a matching `vX.Y.Z` tag. It checks the version, notes and target commit, refuses existing releases, builds/tests all projects, signs the client and verifies that signature before publishing.
- Store release descriptions in `.github/release-notes/<version>.md` and pending changes in `UNRELEASED.md`. Normal development and branch pushes do not publish releases or increment versions.
- Add `prepareRelease` for local or CI preparation of the client, its signature, the Paper plugin and SHA-256 sums without publication.

## Upgrade notes

Replace the previous Paper plugin with `DUM-SDK-Paper-0.14.1.jar`. DUM-Core is no longer required by SDK; other plugins may still need it. Existing SDK configuration, message overrides and published module data can be retained.

The client download remains `DUM-SDK.jar`, with `DUM-SDK.jar.sig` for verified automatic updates. There is no wire protocol change in this release.

## Validation

- Local macOS build and 27 unit tests, including message creation, old-file overrides, fallback defaults, lists, empty strings, placeholders and reload.
- Local Paper with only DUM-SDK installed: three client joins, two `/dumsdk reload` disconnects/reconnects and bundled Russian reconnect text, using an old incomplete config and messages file.
- Existing client game test against standalone Paper with the external info/runtime fixtures and no Core: module download, public API, tagged items, equipment callbacks, optional module failure and reconnect.
- Release workflow linting, shell syntax checks, preflight refusal cases, independent signature/checksum verification and checks that private key bytes are absent from jars.
- Real release publication is performed by the linked Actions run for tag v0.14.1. Additional manual Windows/client checks and live server deployment remain unchecked; see `CHECKLIST.md`.
